t0308-01.gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
t0308-01.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

t0308-02.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
t0308-02.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
